references.text: The Lord tells Moses that the people's heart is hardened, which mirrors Jesus' observation of the disciples' hearts in Mark 8:17.
The psalm urges not to have a heart like their ancestors in the wilderness, who did not understand God's work, paralleling the disciples' lack of understanding in Mark 8:17.
Isaiah is told by God that the people will hear but not understand, and see but not perceive, which resembles Jesus' criticism of the disciples' lack of insight in Mark 8:17.
Jesus explains why he speaks in parables and refers to the people's heart as hardened, paralleling his observation in Mark 8:17.
Jesus criticizes the disciples' lack of understanding and faith regarding the miracles with the loaves, directly related to the event and his statement in Mark 8:17.
